changelog:
- Bottom-Pinned Command Card: Anchored the Ask AI command card to the bottom of the screen with automatic keyboard insets adjustment so the keyboard never obscures input.
- Action Row Redesign: Removed redundant plus and verify pills, positioned the circular voice input button on the left, and added the enter/send button on the right.
- Independent Chat Scroll View: Added dedicated scroll container for Ask AI responses ensuring seamless scrolling above the pinned bottom command card.
- Build Fixes: Resolved Kotlin destructuring component count and forward-reference function calls.
